task: Reconcile inherited W12 and R7-006 ownership changes against phase28-work and evaluate the 56-fixture certified oracle.
observation: Running tests/phase28/oracle/oracle_harness.py together with structured ./moss check --json diagnostics immediately isolated the two fixable inherited regressions in the merged tree (missing RESERVED_KEYWORD on user-defined fn copy in ORACLE-08, and premature OWNERSHIP_COLLECTION_ELEMENT_CONSUME on borrow definition in ORACLE-14) while cleanly separating 18 semantic failures from 29 clone-provenance sidecar blocks.
impact: Allowed targeted checker repairs in src/semantic_checker.cpp that increased fully passing oracle fixtures from 8 to 11 and reduced semantic failures from 34 to 18 without trial-and-error debugging.

resolution.summary: Repaired RESERVED_KEYWORD declaration checks for copy, EST-based take/copy type inference, and indexed borrow definition clamping on phase28-r7-008-integration.

task: Diagnose why ORACLE-03-COLL-ELEM-CONSUME-REJECT reported WRONG_DIAGNOSTIC despite the checker rejecting line 10 with OWNERSHIP_COLLECTION_ELEMENT_CONSUME.
observation: In tests/phase28/oracle/fixtures/oracle_03_collection_element_consume_rejected.moss, line 10 is 'let x = consume_resource(v[0])', whereas tests/phase28/oracle/diagnostic_mapping.json requires source_line_regex 'push|head\[0\]' (which only appears in the comment on line 1).
impact: The certified oracle harness reports WRONG_DIAGNOSTIC on ORACLE-03 even when the checker rejects the exact consuming call at line 10 with OWNERSHIP_COLLECTION_ELEMENT_CONSUME; because the oracle is frozen by SHA-256 pins, the mismatch must be documented rather than edited during staging integration.

resolution.summary: Preserved the frozen certified oracle unchanged per P28-R7-008 rules and documented the ORACLE-03 source_line_regex mismatch in the integration report.
